test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

A balloon __contracts__ when air is blown into it.
solution: The correct answer is** 'expands'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined word** 'contracts' **means to become or to make something smaller or shorter. (संकुचित होना या करना; सिकुड़ना, संक्षिप्‍त होना या करना) • **Example: ***Metals**** contract ****on cooling and expands on heating.* • *​*The marked option** 'expands'** means to become or to make something bigger. (कुछ बड़ा बनना या बनाना) • Therefore, from the given meanings, it is clear that '**expands**' and **'contracts' **are antonyms. • Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's have a look at the **meaning **of the words given in options:- • **Controls - **determine the behaviour or supervise the running of. (नियंत्रण) • **Repulses - **drive back (an attack or attacker) by force; cause to feel intense distaste and aversion. (बल द्वारा पीछे हटाना; तीव्र अरुचि और घृणा महसूस करने का कारण) • **Shrinks - **become or make smaller in size or amount. (आकार या राशि में छोटा होना या बनना) 17c:Tb53, The correct answer is** 'vacant'.**
